name: USSF-366
description: USSF-366 is a classified mission for the United States Space Force. It is possibly a batch of classified LEO satellites for a US government entity based on SpaceX’s Starshield satellite bus, based on locations of rocket stage drop zones being exact fits with previous Starlink Group 15 launches.
rocket_fact: The Falcon 9's engines are arranged in an 'Octaweb' pattern to contain blast damage.
